text:
Sam C: vendor says 16 A100s available in us-west2 for overnight window (20:00-06:00). Can we slot them into the standby pool? Need quota check + billing tag. /cc @Jia L @Miguel
Jia L: checking quotas now — which project id should we use? Also is this inference-only or training? If inference-only we might be ok with smaller instance shapes. Running `gcloud compute reservations describe standby-pool --project=infra-standby` to inspect current usage.
Miguel: for infra changes we need AMI bake + startup-script changes. I'll look at the infra PR when it's up. Ping me on the PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4221
Priya: cost note: 16 A100s on-demand overnight ~ $XX/hr each. Vendor mentioned some are spot-preemptible. If budget matters we could do 8 reserved + 8 spot. That keeps cost predictable and gives headroom.
vendor-ops-bot: reservation 89f3b created (ETA ~2h). Details: https://vendor.example/slots/89f3b. Tagging: vendor=acme-gpu, region=us-west2.
Sam C: thanks. Jia can you confirm current quota and whether project `infra-standby` has billing tag `standby-pool-prod`? If quota is OK I'll open a small TF PR to add the reservation and attach the billing tag.
Jia L: quota is tighter than I hoped — project quota: 32 A100 total, current usage: 18. That leaves 14 free, so 16 won't fit as-is. Two paths: request a temporary quota bump of +8 A100, or borrow 6 from `staging-standby` (they currently show 6 free slots).
Miguel: I can do a quick review. @Sam C please include the diffs for `instance_template.gpu` and the `billing` tag. Also add a canary smoke-test in `ci/canary` that validates model load latency.
Priya: mixing borrow + vendor spot seems reasonable: borrow 6 from staging + vendor 10 spot = 16. Cost around ~60% of pure on-demand. I approve that approach if oncall is okay.
Sam C: created infra PR with the minimal changes: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4230 — adds reservation entry, billing tag, and a tiny canary job. Requesting @Miguel review.
Miguel: reviewing now. small nit: startup-script indentation and a missing `set -e` at top. will request changes and approve after fix.
Jia L: I'll open the quota bump request with cloud provider for +8 A100 (ETA ~24h). Meanwhile I'll open a short-lived permission to borrow those 6 from `staging-standby` so we can proceed sooner.
Sam C: perfect — plan: attempt borrow + vendor spot mix immediately. If quota bump lands, we'll move to full vendor reservation and scale down staging borrow. I'll post schedule once vendor confirms exact time. :thumbsup:
